name: Manhattan Village
description: Manhattan Village is a premier open-air shopping destination in Manhattan Beach, California, offering an upscale retail experience with a carefully curated mix of fashion, lifestyle, and dining options. Located on Sepulveda Boulevard, this coastal shopping center features contemporary architecture and serves the affluent South Bay community with both national brands and local boutiques. The center provides a sophisticated shopping environment that reflects the beach city lifestyle of its surrounding neighborhood.
summary: Manhattan Village is an upscale open-air shopping center serving the affluent Manhattan Beach community with premium retail, dining, and lifestyle offerings.
